instruction: I want a more compact email interface to see more messages at once. Can you enable the compact view mode in Thunderbird?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling compact view mode in Thunderbird for a denser UI. The evaluator verifies that mail.uidensity preference is set to 1, which represents compact density mode. This setting reduces spacing in the message list and UI elements to display more content on screen.
